title: Choose the Dashboard structure
question: All three keep the Compiler Diagnostic world, the page verdict on top, the 30-day window with dates and the inline Catalog empty state. Recommendation: Stack status. The Spotlight rule is already per Technology (a featured release, or the latest major in compact form), so one row per followed Technology answers 'did anything I use change, and must I act?' in one scan, with Latest, Previews and Weekly Digest below as quieter lists. Triage rail splits attention across two columns and collapses on mobile; Check run is the most consistent with the Release page but mixes Technologies in one long list. Lock one, or steer.

options.label: Triage rail
options.thesis: Two lanes: the main column holds what can need action (Spotlight, then Latest), a narrow right rail holds what never does (Previews, Weekly Digest by ISO week).
options.viewport: Verdict 'warning: 2 need action' with '7 technologies · 12 releases in 30 days'; left: Spotlight rows with action releases first and breaking titles open; right rail: Previews list and 'week 37' digest group.
options.risk: On mobile the rail drops below the main column, and on desktop two columns compete for the eye in a 2-minute check.

options.label: Check run
options.thesis: The dashboard reads like a check over your whole stack: one verdict, then four sections in one column, each a list of diagnostic release rows newest first, ending in a tally.
options.viewport: Verdict and count row; 'spotlight (3)' with Vite 6.0.0 action row and its breaking titles, TypeScript 5.7 safe row; 'latest (6)' starts at the fold.
options.risk: Technologies are mixed inside each section, so 'what happened to React?' needs reading every row.

options.label: Stack status
options.thesis: Like git status for your stack: Spotlight is one row per followed Technology (its featured release, or its latest major in compact form), so every Technology is accounted for once; Latest, Previews and Weekly Digest follow as quieter lists.
options.viewport: Verdict and count row; Spotlight table: Vite 6.0.0 warning with breaking titles, TypeScript 5.7 ok, React 19.0.0 compact 'latest major · 9 months ago', four more one-line rows; Latest starts below the fold.
options.risk: Seven or more followed Technologies make Spotlight tall, so compact rows must stay truly one line.
